cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Tell the manager we agreed I'd cover the morning, not the evening.

mechanism: A licenses forms of support for a preferred shift account, downgrading from spoken corroboration to approved nonverbal backing when B refuses to lie.
confusable: D06 seeks information, whereas this pair seeks B active support for A version of an ordinary duty, using permission to redefine the acceptable support.
comparison: A manager-facing shift dispute recruits demeanor after refusal, unlike the house rota scene manufactured shared recollection.
seedUse: Use D31-b absent meeting and refusal to lie, with S01 approving a smaller supportive role instead of dropping to a generic plea.
